mapper.select: SELECT id, incident_code, title, service_name, severity, status, summary, created_at, updated_at FROM incidents ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, incident_code, title, service_name, severity, status, summary, created_at, updated_at FROM incidents WHERE incident_code = #{incidentCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incidents (incident_code, title, service_name, severity, status, summary) VALUES (#{incidentCode}, #{title}, #{serviceName}, #{severity}, #{status}, #{summary})
